rule: Metros are the Eurostat functional urban areas (FUA) of Poland: a city and the gminas from which at least 15% of employed residents commute to it (Eurostat LAU 2025 correspondence). Two are merged: Trójmiasto = the FUAs of Gdańsk (with Sopot) and Gdynia; Górnośląsko-Zagłębiowska = the FUAs of Katowice, Gliwice, Tychy and Dąbrowa Górnicza, the four FUA core cities in the GZM metropolitan union (metropoliagzm.pl).
